newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UN refugee agency monitoring Albania unrest.
newsitem.headline: UN refugee agency monitoring Albania unrest.

text.p: The United Nations refugee agency is closely monitoring the unrest in Albania but has not yet detected any significant exodus of refugees, a spokesman said on Tuesday.
Kris Janowski, spokesman of the U.N. High Commissioner for Refugees, said the agency had two delegates in the Italian port of Brindisi who were keeping tabs on border crossings.
"We've not had any reports of any significant numbers of people leaving Albania," Janowski told a news briefing in Geneva in response to a reporter's query.
"At this point we are just basically monitoring the situation. But as of now there has been no outflow of people."

Janowski added: "So we have not faced a problem yet even though of course we are alarmed by the situation which is very tense and doesn't seem to be resolved yet. We are watching it and hoping for the best."
Italy's Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini has cancelled a trip to India so he can remain in Italy to follow the Albanian crisis, the Rome Foreign Ministry said on Tuesday.
Italy has been active in seeking a peaceful end to the unrest and has bolstered its military presence in the Adriatic out of fear that all-out war could trigger an exodus.
